usage: finalize_session.py [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--summary SUMMARY]
                           [--file FILE] [--version VERSION] [--keep-legacy]

Finalize session and update the project's consolidated master summary in
ChromaDB

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT  Project name (default: git repository root name)
  --summary SUMMARY  Full consolidated master summary text
  --file FILE        Path to text/markdown file containing master summary
  --version VERSION  Optional project version the summary refers to
  --keep-legacy      Do not delete raw turn chunks
